subject: On-prem license & operator-handover — redlines and retention questions (NimbleHealth)
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@nimblehealth.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.inference.com, ben.carter@redwood.inference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: On-prem license & retention redlines (NimbleHealth)

Hi Ava / Ben,

Thanks for the call yesterday. Attached is the NimbleHealth redline of the On-Prem Addendum (v3). Our legal team has a few asks we want to resolve before we sign the Order Form:

- Clarify operator access scope for monitoring and incident response (page 2, section 3).
- Requested a 30-day audit window and clear evidence list (we called this out on p.5).
- They want explicit language for customer-controlled key custody and a fallback escrow option if HSM handback cannot be completed within the onboarding window.

I've attached the redline and a short internal checklist. Can Redwood confirm the following by EOD Monday: whether you can accept an operator access limitation (read-only metrics + runbook-triggered escalation), whether escrow can be used as a short-term fallback, and a realistic timeline for producing the evidence set we need for our SOC prep?

Tony Liu (cc'd on follow-up threads) will be our technical lead for the audit work. Legal will likely push a couple of small language changes around license scope / indemnity.

Thanks — appreciate a clear mutual action plan so we can keep the procurement timeline intact.

Best,
Elena Park
Director, Procurement — NimbleHealth

Attachments: Nimble_OnPrem_Addendum_v3_redlines.docx (track changes), nimble-evidence-request.xlsx
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: On-prem license & retention redlines (NimbleHealth)

Elena — thanks for the redline and the clear asks. We can take this on; below is a high-level mutual action plan and what we'll need from you to keep the deal on the current timeline.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) Redwood to provide a point-by-point response to the attached redline by Fri Mar 26 COB (we will: accept some operator limits, propose a precise monitoring API scope, and propose an alternate escrow workflow).
2) Technical rehearsal: exchange runbooks and an evidence stub by Tue Mar 30 so both teams can map data retention and access controls.
3) Legal sync: internal redlines back to Nimble legal by Wed Mar 31; aim to resolve non-material license language by Apr 5.

Quick clarifications we need from Nimble to prepare:
- Confirm whether the requested 30-day audit window is fixed or negotiable (some customers request a rolling 30-day snapshot vs. a single scheduled window).
- Which evidence items are must-haves vs. optional (the attached checklist groups these; mark must-have items).
- Any compliance-specific contacts beyond Tony (e.g., SOC lead).

We will attach our evidence checklist and a suggested operator-role matrix in the internal thread. Karthik, can Legal prioritize a view on the escrow fallback language and customer-key custody tonight? Ben — can you confirm whether the sales order form requires any internal discount approvals tied to the on-prem path?

Ava Chen
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: NimbleHealth on-prem — commercial/approvals note

Team — internal summary to keep legal/solutions aligned before we send formal responses to Nimble.

Context: Nimble is moving from Proof-of-Concept into an enterprise Order Form; they prefer On-Prem for PHI adjacency. The redline touches operator access, escrow, and evidence timing. Risks: longer procurement cycle if escrow language requires C-suite approval or if legal pushes operator access beyond our standard operator-only monitoring scope.

Proposed commercial guardrails:
- No change to list price for the initial 12-month Order Form; any special escrow or custodian costs to be passed through (we can absorb minor admin fees).
- If Nimble requires permanent operator-side key custody, escalate to Sales Ops & Finance for a pricing addendum.
- Approve acceptance of a temporary escrow fallback (90-day max) for onboarding only; require automatic handback acceptance criteria in the runbook.

Karthik — if you can draft language that: (a) allows a 30-day audit window as either scheduled or rolling (we'll propose rolling by default), and (b) sets an explicit operator-access scope (metrics + orchestration triggers, no data plane reads) that should be acceptable to Nimble legal, we'll send the response to Elena this afternoon.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com

Attachment referenced internally: operator-handover-template.xlsx
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: On-prem license & retention redlines (NimbleHealth)

Elena — quick update and attached our responses/annotations. High level: we can accept the majority of your redline with the following positions:

- Operator access: Redwood will operate in a constrained operator role (read-only metrics, alert triggers, runbook-driven remediation). We will not have data-plane read access. We have attached an operator-role matrix that maps each allowed action to a runbook step.
- Audit window: We propose a rolling 30-day snapshot as our standard. If Nimble requires a scheduled 30-day window instead, we can accommodate but will need explicit calendar notice; both approaches are described in the evidence checklist.
- Escrow / key custody: We will support customer-controlled keys as the default. For customers who request temporary escrow, we can accept a 90-day onboarding escrow with a documented handback checklist and acceptance criteria. Karthik has proposed fallback language in the addendum to cover attestation, proof-of-possession, and rekeying timelines.

Next steps: please review the attached annotated addendum (Nimble_OnPrem_Addendum_v3_redlines.docx) and our evidence checklist. If you can mark the must-have evidence items on your checklist and confirm whether you prefer rolling vs scheduled audit windows, we will produce a final tracked-change document by Thu Apr 1. Also sending you a DocuSign link for the updated Order Form once Nimble confirms the evidence list.

If helpful, Tony/your SOC lead and our security engineering team can do a 30-minute technical walkthrough on Wed Mar 31. Let us know a time.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Nimble_OnPrem_Addendum_v3_redlines.docx (with Redwood annotations); redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf; operator-handover-template.xlsx
